_comment: Reviewer arms. The 2026-07 gpt-5.5 -> gpt-5.6 evaluation ran with A as control; after the GO verdict (66-run blinded 4-arm campaign, campaigns/2026-07-gpt56-VERDICT.md) gpt-5.6-sol @ xhigh became production, so B carries role=control and A is retained as the previous-production arm for future back-comparisons. The 2026-10 campaign (campaigns/2026-10-gpt6-VERDICT.md, DECISION_RULE.md) compares B (control) against E (gpt-6-astra @ xhigh, the candidate); E's FIRST corpus run is the campaign itself (pre-registration by construction). treatment_fields declares which Config fields are the experimental treatment; every other confound (sandbox / action_version / cli_version, plus effort when not declared) is pinned and asserted identical across arms, and every selected multi-arm subset must decompose into single-field contrasts (see eval_core.runner). cli_version re-pinned to codex-cli 0.162.1 on 2026-10-16 (one CLI serves all arms and the runner asserts the live `codex --version` matches): B @ xhigh verified by harness smoke on 0.162.1; E = gpt-6-astra @ xhigh accepted by a `codex exec` probe on 0.162.1 (the exact argv `_build_codex_cmd` emits, under an isolated CODEX_HOME); A, C and D are historical 2026-07 arms NOT re-verified on 0.162.1 (D's `max` included; an unsupported effort fails closed as INFRA_ERROR). Astra off-corpus latency probe (2026-10-16, codex-cli 0.162.1, isolated CODEX_HOME, production openai_review.py on merged PR #841, 554 changed lines, effort xhigh): real = 324.57 s wall-clock, 14 shell commands, 26 web-search events; below the 1800 s threshold, so CALL_TIMEOUT_S stays 3600. Contrast check: B -> E differ in `model` only.
